### 4b. Code entries

From the catalog (`.foundry/catalog/catalog.json`, extracted from the code). Each line: **name** `where` [kind] the job it does. Use: canonical usage.

#### Class `tenancy`
- **Organization** `packages/db/prisma/schema/organization.prisma` [model] top-level tenant owning users, spaces, integrations, tokens and content Use: db.organization.findUnique({ where: { slug } })
- **OrganizationUser** `packages/db/prisma/schema/organizationUser.prisma` [model] hold a user's membership, role and entitlements in one organization Use: db.organizationUser.findUnique({ where: { organizationId_userId: { organizationId, userId } } })
- **Space** `packages/db/prisma/schema/space.prisma` [model] hold a tenant workspace inside an organization, scoping its users, tags, templates and integrations Use: db.space.findUnique({ where: { organizationId_slug: { organizationId, slug } } })
- **SpaceUser** `packages/db/prisma/schema/spaceUser.prisma` [model] grant a user a role and entitlements within one space, tied to their org membership Use: db.spaceUser.findUnique({ where: { organizationId_spaceId_userId: { organizationId, spaceId, userId } } })
- **CreateOrganizationModal** `packages/ui/src/components/organizations/CreateOrganizationModal.tsx#CreateOrganizationModal` [primitive] collect a new organization's name and auto-derived, uniqueness-checked slug Use: <CreateOrganizationModal isOpen={open} onClose={close} onSubmit={(name, slug) => create(name, slug)} />
- **OrganizationProfilePage** `packages/ui/src/pages/OrganizationProfilePage.tsx#OrganizationProfilePage` [primitive] show and edit the current organization's profile Use: <OrganizationProfilePage />
- **OrganizationSpacesPage** `packages/ui/src/pages/OrganizationSpacesPage.tsx#OrganizationSpacesPage` [primitive] list the spaces belonging to an organization Use: <OrganizationSpacesPage organizationId={orgId} />
- **validateNotLastOwner** `apps/api/src/modules/organization/validations/validateNotLastOwner.ts#validateNotLastOwner` [primitive] block removing or demoting an organization's last owner Use: await validateNotLastOwner(db, orgId)
- **apps/admin/app/routes/_authenticated/organizations** `apps/admin/app/routes/_authenticated/organizations` [system] list the user's organizations and manage organization invitations in admin Use: add organization pages under apps/admin/app/routes/_authenticated/organizations
- **apps/admin/app/routes/_authenticated/spaces** `apps/admin/app/routes/_authenticated/spaces` [system] list spaces and handle space applications and incoming transfers in admin Use: add space pages under apps/admin/app/routes/_authenticated/spaces
- **apps/admin/app/routes/_authenticated/users** `apps/admin/app/routes/_authenticated/users` [system] list users, members and user invitations in admin Use: add user/member pages under apps/admin/app/routes/_authenticated/users
- **apps/api/src/modules/organization** `apps/api/src/modules/organization` [system] create, read, update, delete organizations and their scoped contacts, segments, tokens, webhooks Use: apps/api/src/modules/organization — add org-scoped endpoints as organizationCreateX / organizationReadManyX
- **apps/api/src/modules/organizationUser** `apps/api/src/modules/organizationUser` [system] read, update, delete an organization membership and issue tokens for it Use: apps/api/src/modules/organizationUser — organizationUserRead / organizationUserUpdate / organizationUserDelete
- **apps/api/src/modules/space** `apps/api/src/modules/space` [system] read, update, delete spaces and their scoped contacts, customers, segments, tokens, webhooks Use: apps/api/src/modules/space — add space-scoped endpoints as spaceCreateX / spaceReadManyX
- **apps/api/src/modules/spaceUser** `apps/api/src/modules/spaceUser` [system] read, update, delete a space membership and issue tokens for it Use: apps/api/src/modules/spaceUser — spaceUserRead / spaceUserUpdate / spaceUserDelete
- **apps/web/app/routes/_authenticated/organizations** `apps/web/app/routes/_authenticated/organizations` [system] list the user's organizations and manage organization invitations in the web app Use: add organization pages under apps/web/app/routes/_authenticated/organizations
- **apps/web/app/routes/_authenticated/spaces** `apps/web/app/routes/_authenticated/spaces` [system] list spaces, their applications and incoming space transfers Use: add space pages under apps/web/app/routes/_authenticated/spaces
- **apps/web/app/routes/_authenticated/users** `apps/web/app/routes/_authenticated/users` [system] show tenant members and manage user invitations Use: add member pages under apps/web/app/routes/_authenticated/users

#### Class `permissions`
- **Role** `packages/db/prisma/schema/user.prisma` [model] grade tenant access as owner, admin, member or viewer Use: import { Role } from '@prisma/client'
- **actionRuleSchema** `@inixiative/permissions/actionRuleSchema#actionRuleSchema` [package] validate serialized tenant or row-level permission overrides before persisting them Use: actionRuleSchema.parse(override) // import { actionRuleSchema } from '@inixiative/permissions/actionRuleSchema'
- **createHydrator** `@inixiative/permissions#createHydrator` [package] load a record's to-one parent chain so rebac checks see full relations Use: const hydrate = createHydrator({ parents, load })
- **createPermissions** `@inixiative/permissions#createPermissions` [package] create a typed permix instance for role-based action checks Use: const permissions = createPermissions<Action>()
- **createRebacCheck** `@inixiative/permissions#createRebacCheck` [package] evaluate rebac, ABAC and role rules on hydrated records, including cross-source hops Use: const check = createRebacCheck(resolveRelation)
- **buildPermissionRulesSchema** `packages/permissions/src/rebac/permissionRulesSchema.ts#buildPermissionRulesSchema` [primitive] validate row-level permissionRules JSON against the model's valid rebac action keys Use: import { buildPermissionRulesSchema } from '@template/permissions/rebac/permissionRulesSchema'
- **check** `packages/permissions/src/rebac/check.ts#check` [primitive] decide whether an actor may perform an action on a record via ReBAC schema plus row rules Use: check(permix, rebacSchema, 'email', record, 'read')
- **checkPermission** `packages/ui/src/hooks/usePermission.ts#checkPermission` [primitive] check whether the permissions slice allows an action on a model record, outside React Use: checkPermission(permissions, model, record, action)
- **createPermissions** `packages/permissions/src/client.ts#createPermissions` [primitive] build a typed Permix permissions client for checks Use: const permix = createPermissions()
- **getOrgPermissions** `packages/permissions/src/roles/organization.ts#getOrgPermissions` [primitive] build an actor's permission set from their org role and entitlements Use: getOrgPermissions(role, orgId, entitlements)
- **getSpacePermissions** `packages/permissions/src/roles/space.ts#getSpacePermissions` [primitive] build ReBAC permission rules for a role within one space, applying entitlements Use: getSpacePermissions(role, spaceId, entitlements)
- **getUserPermissions** `packages/permissions/src/roles/user.ts#getUserPermissions` [primitive] build ReBAC permission rules for a user acting on their own user record Use: getUserPermissions(userId, role, entitlements)
- **greaterRole** `packages/permissions/src/roles/shared.ts#greaterRole` [primitive] return the highest of several roles, ignoring nulls Use: greaterRole(orgRole, spaceRole)
- **isSuperadmin** `packages/permissions/src/roles/shared.ts#isSuperadmin` [primitive] check whether a user holds the platform superadmin role Use: if (isSuperadmin(user)) { ... }
- **lesserRole** `packages/permissions/src/roles/shared.ts#lesserRole` [primitive] pick the lowest of several roles, ignoring null or undefined Use: const effective = lesserRole(orgRole, spaceRole);
- **ownerActions** `packages/permissions/src/rebac/ownerActions.ts#ownerActions` [primitive] generate own/manage/operate/read rules fanning out across user, organization, space owner FKs Use: actions: { ...ownerActions() } // in rebacSchema entry for owner-polymorphic models
- **polymorphicBindings** `packages/db/src/registries/polymorphicIs.ts#polymorphicBindings` [primitive] build rule binds for an owner kind and id Use: polymorphicBindings('Organization', orgId)
- **polymorphicIs** `packages/db/src/registries/polymorphicIs.ts#polymorphicIs` [primitive] compile a rule condition matching rows whose polymorphic axis points at the bound row Use: polymorphicIs('Contact', 'owner')
- **rebacSchema** `packages/permissions/src/rebac/schema.ts#rebacSchema` [primitive] declare per-model ReBAC actions and relation rules the app enforces Use: import { rebacSchema } from '@template/permissions/rebac/schema'
- **rolesAtOrAbove** `packages/permissions/src/roles/shared.ts#rolesAtOrAbove` [primitive] list every role at or above a given role in the hierarchy Use: where: { role: { in: rolesAtOrAbove('admin') } }
- **setupOrgPermissions** `apps/api/src/lib/permissions/setupOrgPermissions.ts#setupOrgPermissions` [primitive] load organization-scoped permissions into the request's permix instance Use: await setupOrgPermissions(c)
- **setupSpacePermissions** `apps/api/src/lib/permissions/setupSpacePermissions.ts#setupSpacePermissions` [primitive] load space-scoped permissions into the request's permix instance Use: await setupSpacePermissions(c)
- **setupUserPermissions** `apps/api/src/lib/permissions/setupUserPermissions.ts#setupUserPermissions` [primitive] load user-scoped permissions into the request's permix instance Use: await setupUserPermissions(c)
- **StandardAction** `packages/permissions/src/client.ts#StandardAction` [primitive] define the shared read/operate/manage action set resources spread Use: export const FooAction = { ...StandardAction } as const;
